title: TUDA transporters' roadblock campaign, February continuation

start_date.summary: TN says Transportes Unidos de Argentina launched the protest in mid-January; exact physical start day remains unresolved, consistent with January review's 15–17 January range.

continued_date.summary: TN reports on 4 February that road protests remained in Buenos Aires while truck operations in Santa Fe had improved.

location.summary: Buenos Aires road protests continued; specific sites are not identified in the extracted paragraphs.

demands.summary: The campaign sought regulated/updateable freight rates tied to transport costs.

attendance.summary: Truck volumes/operating percentages are not a count of people at a public gathering.

state_response.summary: A Transport Ministry negotiation on 4 February involved national transport chambers; TUDA was explicitly not invited. No TUDA accommodation or outcome is established.

notes: This is a cross-month continuation, not a new February event. Do not infer a specific January onset day from 'mid-January', or closure from improved truck operation in Santa Fe. Government talks with industry chambers did not include TUDA. January unit episode_key: argentina_tuda_2021-01.
open_questions: Resolve the exact physical onset among January reports and whether separate road sites form one campaign.
Verify February site-level attendance, any actual TUDA-government meeting, and the physical end of all road assemblies.
